lines.en: I swim slowly through cold water.
My long flipper clips the surface.
A swarm of krill lies ahead.

lines.zh: 我张口吞下一大口海水。
lines.en: I take a great mouthful of sea.

lines.zh: 我翻了个身，露出白色的腹。
lines.en: I roll, showing a pale belly.

lines.zh: 我在深海里游行得很慢。
lines.en: I cruise the deep, unhurried.
One tail beat moves the water.
I surface to breathe.

lines.zh: 冷水里，我的体重轻了一些。
lines.en: In cold water I feel lighter.

lines.zh: 我跟着磷虾群绕了一圈。
lines.en: I follow the krill swarm around.

lines.zh: 我的歌声在水下传得很远。
lines.en: My song carries far underwater.
I skim above the seabed.
Water strains through my mouth.
I turn slowly beneath the ice.
Old scars mark my back.
I rise, then sink again.
I cross the deep blue without hurry.
My tail stirs up a cloud of bubbles.
Hanging in the water, breathing slow.
Quiet down here. Only water.
I listen to a distant song.
My flippers hang at my sides.
The pressure feels pleasant.

lines.zh: 我的歌声能穿过整片深海。
lines.en: My song crosses the cold deep.
Krill swirl at my mouth.

lines.zh: 我悬在冷水里，长鳍垂着。
lines.en: I hang in the cold water, long fins hanging.

lines.zh: 海面的光透过水照下来。
lines.en: Light filters down from above.
I count the floes overhead.
Small marks on my skin.
The tide is turning. I'll wait.
I know these waters.

lines.zh: 我慢慢地吐出一串气泡。
lines.en: I release a string of bubbles.
So small, up there on the water.
I have seen your boat from below.

lines.zh: 别靠太近，我的尾巴很宽。
lines.en: Not too close. My tail is wide.
You are clumsy in the water.
I am in these cold waters.
My eye is bigger than your head.
You do not look like krill.
I do not eat people.
I want to see what you carry.
Back off and I will surface.

lines.zh: 我的皮肤上多了一道痕。
lines.en: A new mark on my skin.

lines.zh: 我沉了半截，又浮上来换气。
lines.en: I sink halfway, then rise to breathe.
I beat my tail and correct.

lines.zh: 皮上多了道划痕，海水一冲就好。
lines.en: A new scratch; seawater will wash it clean.
My song stops for a beat.
The water scatters and closes.
I do not cry out. Whales rarely do.
I circle the boat once.

lines.zh: 我记住你这艘船的样子了。
lines.en: I'll remember the look of your boat.
I can still swim.
Raw krill? That I want.
That fish is too small.
A swarm, not one fish.
Scatter the krill into the water.

lines.zh: 这味道，从很远就闻到了。
lines.en: I smelled that from far off.
Not bread. Not grass.

lines.zh: 你把东西丢下水，我来吃。
lines.en: Drop it in and I will feed.
That handful is not one mouthful.
Thanks. I was hungry.
Any more? I would take more.

lines.zh: 你的船撞在我侧腹，晃得厉害。
lines.en: Your boat hits my flank and rocks hard.

lines.zh: 我的身体比你的船还长。
lines.en: I am longer than your boat.
I shift aside; water shoves away.

lines.zh: 你站在我背上，我沉了一点。
lines.en: You stand on my back. I sink a little.
Do not grab my flipper. It slips.
A bump is nothing to me.

lines.zh: 我一摆尾，你就被推开了。
lines.en: One tail beat pushes you away.

lines.zh: 船在你身后晃得很厉害。
lines.en: Your boat rocks behind you.

lines.zh: 我一张嘴，磷虾就进来了。
lines.en: One open mouth and the krill pour in.

lines.zh: 我浮起来，你就站不稳了。
lines.en: I surface and your footing fails.

lines.zh: 我们的歌，就是为这个唱的。
lines.en: Our songs are for that.

lines.zh: 冷水海域，才是我们的地方。
lines.en: Cold seas are our ground.
My song carries far.
You ask quietly.

lines.zh: 成对游的时候，水都变了。
lines.en: Swimming in pairs stirs the water.
Only one of me here.

lines.zh: 我们在暖海生育，在冷水进食。
lines.en: We breed in warm seas, feed in cold.
Keep off. We are busy.
No need to shout. Water carries it.
Withdraw and let me be.

lines.zh: 我从沙里滤出些小东西。
lines.en: I strain small things from the sand.
I catch what you dropped in.
Sand can be strained for treasure.

lines.zh: 这块石头太重，我吞不下。
lines.en: That stone is too heavy to take.

lines.zh: 我把它留在嘴里，慢慢分。
lines.en: I hold it and sift it slowly.

lines.zh: 你掉的钩子，我吐出来了。
lines.en: I spit out the hook you dropped.

lines.zh: 海水从我的须间流过去。
lines.en: Water passes through my baleen.

lines.zh: 我背上的东西，是你放的？
lines.en: Did you put this on my back?
This is not food.
I strain it and spit it out.
The krill swarm is ahead.

lines.zh: 磷虾群在前头，我张开大嘴。
lines.en: The krill swarm is ahead; I open wide.
I speed that way.
Water floods my mouth.
I chase krill, not people.
You smell of krill.
I fix on that mass of red.
I have the line worked out.
Get to the stern. Do not block.
Now I surge forward.
I circle the swarm.
The water muddies as I churn it.
I rise beneath them.
Bubbles make a net.
The water shoves you off balance.
Mouth open, I pass through.
My tail beats below.
This mouthful will be large.
You are not on the menu.
One more circle is enough.

lines.zh: 我的尾鳍拍起一片白浪。
lines.en: My tail fin slaps up a wall of white water.
I surface; the boat heaves.
That was not deliberate.
The spray pushes you off.
One roll and you are down.

lines.zh: 长鳍擦过你的腿，滑得很。
lines.en: My long fin slides past your leg.
A sheet of sea lifts.
The water hits harder than I.
I sink away. No chase.
Still afloat? Good.

lines.zh: 水面上冒出一大串气泡。
lines.en: A great string of bubbles rises.

lines.zh: 冷水里有个大影子在动。
lines.en: A huge shape stirs in the cold.
I rise slowly from the deep.
The surface bulges.

lines.zh: 你听见一声很远的鲸歌。
lines.en: A distant song.
The krill scatter.
My back breaks the surface.
I swim these waters.
A shadow joins your boat.

lines.zh: 我慢慢转过身，看着上面。
lines.en: I turn and look up.

lines.zh: 火在水面上烧，我躲开了。
lines.en: Fire burns on the surface. I dive away.
I fall back onto the water heavily.
I belong to the water.
The blast booms dully underwater.

lines.zh: 一根鱼叉扎在我的背上。
lines.en: A harpoon sticks in my back.
Arts silence my song.
No krill and my bulk shrinks.

lines.zh: 雷打在海面上，我潜下去了。
lines.en: Lightning hits the sea. I dive.
The seabed splits into void.
